title: The understanding students with 600 more people, and a student that reads the person's words
request: The owner: 'the student model must have more ability' (plan 2026-10-25 Part B2).
spec: State students per workflow point and a text student for problem.family, trained on the new homework and the older journeys, measured on dev beside the rule, judged once on 150 sealed people written apart, under a gate fixed before it.
plan: Collect: play the new people once, merge the older rows, one split per person (the store's).
Train state students and the text student; report dev beside the rule and the rule on the new people.
Write the gate's dev figures, commit, then read the sealed people once.

decisions.decision: A person's split is the store's (datasets.split_of of dataset:journey:<set>:<id>), its sealed share dev.
decisions.why: The kept plays carry the same key: a person trained on here is train in the store too; store-sealed people are never trained on.

decisions.decision: A text student reads the written person's words and answers.
decisions.why: The 26.3 gate's note: a state student cannot read the family (0.526 against the rules' 0.895); the words are invented, so they may be read.

decisions.decision: The gate refuses to run until its dev figures are written into it and committed.
decisions.why: A gate fixed after its sealed set is read is not a gate.

decisions.decision: The sealed people's plays are never kept.
decisions.why: A kept play is shaped by the store: a sealed person would enter training.

change: dclab_rnd/understand_students.py (new: collect, train, gate), dclab_rnd/live_people.py (new, B3), dclab_rnd/lake/answers.py (the sealed guard, the homework split), tests/test_understand_students.py and tests/test_live_people.py (new).

findings.defect: A student on the ledger's state cannot read a person's family.
findings.scenario: problem.family state student 0.498 on dev, 0.51 on the sealed people, against the rule's 0.82.
findings.cause: The state holds counts and flags, never the person's words.
findings.fix: A text student that reads the words.

findings.defect: The state students learned the homework's writer, not the task.
findings.scenario: workflow.next_question 0.876 on dev (the homework writer's people), 0.497 on the sealed people of another writer; problem.ready 0.887 to 0.753; solution.route 0.820 to 0.684.
findings.cause: One writer's people share a style; their states follow it.
findings.fix: More than one writer, and real sessions, before another state student; the sealed set's second writer is what showed it.

findings.defect: The text student reads families better than the rule but turns some of the rule's right answers wrong.
findings.scenario: Sealed: 0.896 accuracy (the bar 0.90), margin over the rule +0.030, 5.6% of the rule's right decisions turned wrong (the bar 0.02).
findings.cause: It replaces the rule everywhere, including where the rule had read the family plainly.
findings.fix: Next version: the rule first, the text student only where the rule reads no family; judged on a new sealed set (this one is spent).

measurements.name: dev (plays of the fixed product)
measurements.gate: each student beside the rule on the same dev rows
measurements.result: text 0.966 against 0.821; state family 0.498; ready 0.887 against 0.827; next question 0.876 against 0.855; route 0.820 against 0.826; the rule on the new people 0.71, 0.71, 0.80, 0.84 against 0.95, 0.96, 0.99, 0.89 on the older ones
limits: dev people of the homework's one writer

measurements.name: the sealed exam (once)
measurements.gate: understand_gate_v1: decision_gate_v1 unchanged, fixed and committed before the read (c0b24002)
measurements.result: no student passed; the text student nearest: accuracy 0.896, precision 0.94, recall 0.89, margin +0.030 over the rule, 5.6% of the rule's right decisions turned wrong, on 67 sealed decisions; the state students 0.51, 0.75, 0.68 and 0.50
limits: 150 sealed people of one other writer; 67 family decisions

outcome: No student passed; the text student reads a person's family better than the rule on another writer's people (+3 points) but turns 5.6% of the rule's right answers wrong; the state students learned the writer. Next: the rule first and the text student where the rule reads nothing, on a new sealed set.
lessons: A second writer for the exam is what shows a student learned the first writer.
A student that beats the rule on average can still be unsafe: count the rule's right answers it breaks.
risks: The state students may still not beat the rule: their state holds no words.
